 The End of Oak Street also stars Ewan McGregor.
 By Tina Campbell Published: 13 November 2026 %0A%09<path d="M240,128a15.74,15.74,0,0,1-7.6,13.51L88.32,229.65a16,16,0,0,1-16.2.3A15.86,15.86,0,0,1,64,216.13V39.87a15.86,15.86,0,0,1,8.12-13.82,16,16,0,0,1,16.2.3L232.4,114.49A15.74,15.74,0,0,1,240,128Z">%0A</path></svg>" width="60" height="60" alt="Play video"/> Anne Hathaway fans have a new thriller to add to their weekend watchlist, with the actor's latest big-screen adventure now available to stream in the UK.
 The End of Oak Street has landed on HBO Max, Sky Cinema and NOW (with a Cinema membership) from today, bringing its dinosaur-filled action to home screens.
 Set in 1982, the sci-fi thriller follows the Platt family, whose seemingly idyllic suburban neighbourhood is suddenly transported into a mysterious prehistoric world.
 Warner Bros. Related: Best streaming services UK 2026 – including Disney Plus, Netflix, iPlayer and Apple TV 
 With their familiar surroundings replaced by a dangerous landscape filled with dinosaurs, the family must put their differences aside and work together if they have any hope of making it out alive.
 As well as facing the terrifying creatures roaming their new surroundings, the family must navigate the challenges of being thrown into an entirely unfamiliar world, where even the most ordinary aspects of everyday life become a fight for survival.
 What to Read Next
 The Devil Wears Prada 2 star leads the cast as mum Denise, alongside Ewan McGregor as husband Greg. Maisy Stella and Christian Convery star as their children Audrey and Brian.
 Written and directed by David Robert Mitchell ( It Follows ), the film combines family drama, sci-fi and creature-feature action, with a nostalgic nod to the adventure blockbusters of the 1980s.
 Critics have been impressed by the film, with The Nightly particularly praising Hathaway's performance.
 Warner Bros. "This is a movie that knows what it is, and what it is, is Hathaway in full mum mode, firing a shotgun at a dinosaur while running in sandals. It's glorious," the publication wrote.
 Vulture also praised the movie, describing it as "a perfect example of what the big studios should be doing right now" and celebrating its commitment to original big-screen spectacles.
 How to watch The End of Oak Street in the UK
 The End of Oak Street is available to stream now on HBO Max, Sky Cinema and NOW with a Cinema membership.
 Sky Cinema gives subscribers access to a range of the latest blockbusters, Sky Original films and movie favourites, making it a good option for anyone looking to keep up with new releases from home.
 You can explore the available packages, find out more about subscription options and sign up through the Sky Cinema website .
